definitions.gloss: to possess both qualities, to combine, to have together
definitions.explanation: To have two or more qualities, abilities, or characteristics at the same time. Implies that having both together is impressive or noteworthy.

examples.english: She possesses both beauty and intelligence.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{機能性|きのうせい}→機能性：25513_kinousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{兼|か}ね{備|そな}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This car combines design and functionality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{決断力|けつだんりょく}→決断力：08521_ketsudanryoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}→柔軟性：05796_juunansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{兼|か}ね{備|そな}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A great leader needs to possess both decisiveness and flexibility.

notes:
Compound verb from ⟦{兼|か}ねる→兼ねる：11668_kaneru⟧ (to combine roles) + ⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧ (to possess, to be equipped with). A somewhat formal expression emphasizing the combination of two desirable qualities.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧B⟦と→と：00512_to⟧C⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{兼|か}ね{備|そな}える (A possesses both B and C)

ASPECT (ている):
- {兼|か}ね{備|そな}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = possesses both (resulting state — the most common form)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{兼|か}ね{備|そな}える (to possess both A and B)
- {兼|か}ね{備|そな}えた + noun (possessing both ~ — modifier form)

USAGE:
Almost always used with two qualities connected by ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧. The て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form is far more common than the dictionary form. The qualities mentioned are typically positive or desirable.
